summary: Focused frontend verification of the sidebar brand logo bug fix on the preview site root. Verified /passport-logo.png asset (HTTP 200, image/png, RGBA with fully transparent corners, ~79% transparent pixels, only ~1.2% opaque-white pixels = wordmark highlights). In-browser: [data-testid='app-logo'] contains 2 imgs; passport img loaded (complete=true, naturalWidth=1672, naturalHeight=941) and ancr-hook img loaded (1536x1024). Both render with transparent background (rgba(0,0,0,0)) directly on the dark sidebar (sidebar bg rgba(7,9,18,0.8)) - no white panel/box. Screenshot confirms silver/chrome PASSPORT wordmark + colorful P visible on dark sidebar. Same-origin fetch('/passport-logo.png') from page returned 200 image/png. No regressions: sidebar nav (Home, Explore, Music Compass and remaining items) visible, dashboard renders, no console/page errors. Page loaded on first attempt (no throttling encountered).

issues: The 'Powered by ANCR' hook image is rendered at only 24x16 px from a 1536x1024 source - the ANCR mark is effectively illegible; consider a larger height or an SVG/wordmark
The tiny tagline line inside the PASSPORT artwork ('CULTURE · LANGUAGE · MUSIC · MOVEMENT') is sub-pixel small at the 210px render width and unreadable
passport-logo.png is 968KB (1672x941) served for a 210px-wide render - consider downscaling/compressing (or WebP) to cut initial payload

action_items: Optional (non-blocking): optimize passport-logo.png file size and increase the 'Powered by' ANCR hook render size for legibility
critical_code_review_comments: Logo.jsx correctly implements onError fallbacks for both images; no issues found. Only nit: 968KB PNG for a 210px logo is an avoidable payload cost.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar logo bug is VERIFIED FIXED. Only cosmetic/perf nits remain (logo file size, tiny hook image). Full app flow testing (Explore, Translator, Music Compass, Travel Ready, etc.) has NOT been performed yet.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: uploaded PASSPORT PNG had a solid white background so it rendered as a white block on the dark sidebar. Fix (flood-fill white -> transparent alpha) is confirmed effective: asset is now RGBA with transparent corners and only wordmark highlights remain white.
